- Split browsing into two tabs, **Home** and **Discover**; L1/R1 switch between them.
- Give Discover a full-screen, Jellyseerr-style catalog with its own sidebar.
- Show an episode's whole 16:9 still on its page instead of a cropped poster.
- Clearer shoulder-button keys, sidebar focus and category shortcut hint.
- Fix a dark band across the top of Home, and Navigation hiding the wrong category
  after Discover was moved.

**Home and Discover** sit in a tab bar at the top of the screen, with L1 and R1
either side. Home glows blue and lists Overview, your libraries and Settings.
Discover glows violet and lists Trending, Popular, Top rated, New releases,
Upcoming and Requests. Switching slides the page in from that side, and each
tab keeps its place: L1 returns to the library and card you left.

**Discover** drops the old Browse/My requests buttons, search box and page
counter. Each category has a large title and count, an All/Movies/Series
filter, larger posters, and more titles load as you scroll. Square opens the
profile menu here too. L1/R1 no longer page Discover, and R3 no longer cycles
the sort; choose the category from the sidebar instead. Hiding **Discover tab**
in Settings → Navigation removes the tab and R1.

**Episodes** now open with the full 16:9 still, a resume bar and the
season/episode code once, beside the synopsis and actions.

**Focus** is clearer: the grid's ring hides while the sidebar has the input,
sidebar dividers line up with the focus highlight, and the L1/R1 and L2/R2 keys
are drawn as keycaps that light up when they do something.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
